content: The latter should align with methodologies proposed by organizations such as the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) or the European Committee for Standardization (CEN). If more information becomes available, a more tailored approach can be adopted. Personal protective equipment (PPE) should only be used as a last resort. If adequate engineering controls are not available, respiratory protective equipment should be used as part of a respiratory protection program, which includes individual fit testing. However, due to limited research, no specific control banding method can be recommended over others. In terms of health monitoring, there is insufficient evidence to recommend specific health surveillance programs tailored to MNMs beyond existing health monitoring programs. Training and worker participation in health and safety matters are considered best practices, but no single training or participation method can be recommended due to a lack of research.
